newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse announces shares changing markets.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse announces shares changing markets.

text.p: The Brussels bourse announced in a statement on Friday a list of Belgian securities transfering from one of its market segments to another with effect from March 12.
Moving up from the semi-continuous forward market to the continuous forward market were shares in Almanij, D'Ieteren, Koramic, Spector and Spector warrants.
Rising from the double fixing cash market to the semi-continuous forward market were Brederode, Creyf's Interim, Telinfo, Financiere d'Obourg and Financiere de Tubize A, and a list of 16 strips.
Electrorail will be demoted from the double fixing cash market to the simple fixing cash market, while Engrais Rosier does the reverse.
